questions.explanation: 根据上下文，Rogan Brown将纸张变成珊瑚礁雕塑，他的作品是艺术与环保结合能产生何种结果的“无数案例/例子（cases）”。A选项effects（效果，影响）虽有迷惑性，但在表达“……的例子”时，cases更符合此处语境（等同于examples）。易错点：误选A或D，忽略了作品本身就是融合艺术与环保的“具体案例”。
questions.supplement:
A(effects)：语境句：The medicine has no side effects on patients. 固定搭配：have an effect on, side effects
B(predictions)：语境句：The scientist made accurate predictions about the weather. 固定搭配：make predictions, accurate predictions
C(cases)：语境句：In some cases, students may need extra help. 固定搭配：in many cases, extreme cases
D(details)：语境句：Please pay attention to the details of the contract. 固定搭配：in detail, go into details

questions.explanation: 空前为raise awareness（提高意识），提高意识的最终目的是“激发改变（inspire change）”，即促使人们采取行动保护珊瑚。固定搭配inspire change意为激发变革。易错点：误选C，虽然激情（passion）也可被激发，但环保题材最终落脚点通常是采取行动做出“改变”。
questions.supplement:
A(wonder)：语境句：The child looked at the stars in wonder. 固定搭配：in wonder, no wonder
B(change)：语境句：We must take action to bring about positive change. 固定搭配：bring about change, inspire change
C(passion)：语境句：She has a strong passion for music and painting. 固定搭配：passion for, have a passion for
D(innovation)：语境句：Technological innovation is the key to economic growth. 固定搭配：technological innovation, encourage innovation

questions.explanation: 前句提到珊瑚礁受到污染和破坏的威胁，后句提到经常能发现珊瑚白化的例子。两者之间是因果关系，即“由于（Because of）”这些威胁，白化现象很常见。易错点：误选C，According to表示“根据”，不表示因果。
questions.supplement:
A(As for)：语境句：As for the plan, we will discuss it tomorrow. 固定搭配：as for me, as for the rest
B(Ahead of)：语境句：He finished the project ahead of schedule. 固定搭配：ahead of time, ahead of schedule
C(According to)：语境句：According to the report, the population is increasing. 固定搭配：according to law, according to the rules
D(Because of)：语境句：The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain. 固定搭配：because of this, just because of

questions.explanation: 根据后半句定语从句“which barely have bright colors（几乎没有明亮的颜色）”以及下文“sees copies of pale, damaged coral（看到苍白、受损的珊瑚）”可知，他使用的是“白色的（white）”纸张。易错点：脱离上下文主观臆断选B（特殊的）或C（废旧的）。
questions.supplement:
A(white)：语境句：She was dressed in a pure white gown. 固定搭配：white lie, in black and white
B(special)：语境句：You need special tools to open this box. 固定搭配：special occasion, special attention
C(used)：语境句：He bought a used car at a lower price. 固定搭配：used to do, get used to
D(colorful)：语境句：The festival was filled with colorful decorations. 固定搭配：colorful life, colorful clothes

questions.explanation: 句意：我们经常把明亮的颜色与健康的珊瑚礁联系在一起。固定搭配 associate ... with ...（把……和……联系起来）。易错点：误选A，compare ... with ... 是“比较”，不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(compare)：语境句：You shouldn't compare your child with others. 固定搭配：compare A with B, compare A to B
B(decorate)：语境句：They decided to decorate the room with balloons. 固定搭配：decorate... with..., beautifully decorated
C(surround)：语境句：The small village is surrounded by high mountains. 固定搭配：be surrounded by, surround oneself with
D(associate)：语境句：People often associate the color red with good luck. 固定搭配：associate with, be associated with

questions.explanation: 观众看到苍白、受损的珊瑚模型，这种环保灾难的展示会给人带来一种“严肃的/沉重的（serious）”感觉。易错点：误选A（好奇的），未能体会文章环保主题的沉重基调。
questions.supplement:
A(curious)：语境句：The curious boy asked a lot of questions. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
B(serious)：语境句：The environmental pollution is a serious problem. 固定搭配：serious problem, take sth seriously
C(content)：语境句：She is quite content with her current life. 固定搭配：be content with, to one's heart's content
D(subjective)：语境句：Art evaluation is often highly subjective. 固定搭配：subjective opinion, subjective judgment

questions.explanation: 上文提到作品主要基于白纸，本句说“有一些颜色进入了他的作品”，说明颜色不是常态，而是“偶尔（Occasionally）”使用。易错点：误选B（自然地），未注意到前后文对比转折关系。
questions.supplement:
A(Hopefully)：语境句：Hopefully, we will reach our destination by noon. 固定搭配：hopefully wait, start hopefully
B(Naturally)：语境句：Naturally, parents want the best for their children. 固定搭配：come naturally, naturally occur
C(Occasionally)：语境句：We occasionally meet for a cup of coffee. 固定搭配：occasionally happen, visit occasionally
D(Obviously)：语境句：Obviously, he didn't prepare well for the exam. 固定搭配：state obviously, quite obviously

questions.explanation: 加入的颜色通常是为了突出白化的珊瑚（白）与健康珊瑚（彩色）之间的“对比（contrast）”。易错点：误选C（冲突），珊瑚之间不存在冲突，而是视觉和状态上的对比。
questions.supplement:
A(contrast)：语境句：There is a sharp contrast between the two cultures. 固定搭配：in contrast to, by contrast
B(interaction)：语境句：Language learning requires constant interaction with others. 固定搭配：social interaction, interaction with
C(conflict)：语境句：The two sides couldn't resolve their long-standing conflict. 固定搭配：in conflict with, resolve a conflict
D(relation)：语境句：The relation between diet and health is complex. 固定搭配：in relation to, international relations

questions.explanation: 下文提到要花大量时间煞费苦心地剪纸和拼贴，说明作品倾注了大量的“汗水/心血（sweat）”。这里sweat是比喻用法，代表辛苦劳作。易错点：误选B或C，虽然艺术品需要想象力和创造力，但紧接着的后一句着重强调了耗时和耐心，因此“汗水（努力）”最贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(pressure)：语境句：Students often face great pressure before exams. 固定搭配：under pressure, peer pressure
B(imagination)：语境句：Reading can stimulate a child's imagination. 固定搭配：rich imagination, beyond imagination
C(creativity)：语境句：The art class encourages children's creativity. 固定搭配：spark creativity, show creativity
D(sweat)：语境句：He wiped the sweat from his forehead after running. 固定搭配：blood and sweat, break a sweat

questions.explanation: 将小纸片应用到大型雕塑上需要极大的“专注力/注意力（attention）”。与前文的painstakingly（煞费苦心地）相呼应。易错点：误选D（支持），拼贴纸张需要的是集中注意力而非支持。
questions.supplement:
A(attention)：语境句：You should pay closer attention to your spelling. 固定搭配：pay attention to, catch one's attention
B(respect)：语境句：We should show respect for the elderly. 固定搭配：show respect for, out of respect
C(contribution)：语境句：He made a great contribution to the company. 固定搭配：make a contribution to, outstanding contribution
D(support)：语境句：I am grateful for your continuous support. 固定搭配：in support of, financial support

questions.explanation: 由But转折和后文提到“每件雕塑都栩栩如生……能提醒人们采取行动”可知，虽然耗时费力，但这项工作是“值得的（worthwhile）”。易错点：误选A或D，忽略了But带来的语意反转（辛苦但是值得）。
questions.supplement:
A(demanding)：语境句：Nursing is a physically and emotionally demanding job. 固定搭配：demanding job, demanding task
B(thorough)：语境句：The police carried out a thorough investigation. 固定搭配：thorough understanding, thorough investigation
C(worthwhile)：语境句：Volunteering at the hospital is a worthwhile experience. 固定搭配：worthwhile effort, make it worthwhile
D(complicated)：语境句：The instructions were too complicated to understand. 固定搭配：complicated situation, complicated process

questions.explanation: 后文说“很难相信我们看到的不是大自然中拍摄的照片”，说明雕塑非常“栩栩如生/逼真（lifelike）”。易错点：误选C（鼓舞人心的），虽然作品有教育意义，但这句具体强调的是外表的真实感。
questions.supplement:
A(classical)：语境句：She enjoys listening to classical music in her free time. 固定搭配：classical music, classical literature
B(lifelike)：语境句：The painter created a very lifelike portrait of the king. 固定搭配：lifelike statue, lifelike appearance
C(inspirational)：语境句：The coach gave an inspirational speech before the game. 固定搭配：inspirational quote, inspirational figure
D(heartwarming)：语境句：It was a heartwarming story about a lost dog finding its home. 固定搭配：heartwarming moment, heartwarming story

questions.explanation: 根据全文主题（艺术与环保结合），艺术品的目的是提醒人们采取行动去“保护（preserve）”珊瑚。易错点：误选C（恢复），recover作及物动词时通常指寻回、收复，preserve（保护、保存）更符合自然保护的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(identify)：语境句：The witness was able to identify the suspect. 固定搭配：identify with, clearly identify
B(explore)：语境句：They decided to explore the mysterious cave. 固定搭配：explore the possibility, explore nature
C(recover)：语境句：It took him a long time to recover from the illness. 固定搭配：recover from, fully recover
D(preserve)：语境句：We must take measures to preserve our cultural heritage. 固定搭配：preserve the environment, well-preserved

questions.explanation: 后文提到他还设计了有珊瑚图案的衣服，说明他的设计并不“局限于（restricted）”雕塑。be restricted to为固定搭配，意为“仅限于”。易错点：误选A，be applied to是“应用于”，not applied to意为“不应用于雕塑”，与事实相悖。
questions.supplement:
A(applied)：语境句：The new rules will be applied to all students. 固定搭配：apply to, apply for
B(restricted)：语境句：Access to the military base is strictly restricted. 固定搭配：be restricted to, highly restricted
C(attached)：语境句：She is deeply attached to her hometown. 固定搭配：be attached to, attach importance to
D(assigned)：语境句：The teacher assigned a lot of homework for the weekend. 固定搭配：assign sb to do, assigned task

questions.explanation: 在时装设计师的邀请下，Brown与她“合作（partnered with）”创作了连衣裙。易错点：误选A（求助于），两人是平等的受邀合作关系，并非单方面求助。
questions.supplement:
A(turned to)：语境句：When he was in trouble, he turned to his parents for help. 固定搭配：turn to sb for help, turn out
B(relied on)：语境句：The region has heavily relied on agriculture for centuries. 固定搭配：rely on, rely upon
C(partnered with)：语境句：Our school partnered with a local charity to raise funds. 固定搭配：partner with, business partner
D(went after)：语境句：The brave dog went after the thief without hesitation. 固定搭配：go after a dream, go after sb

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be famous or well-known because of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，is known for 表示主语（Artist Rogan Brown）以某特点被熟知；一般现在时，第三人称单数。
vocab_pack.example_en: The artist is known for his unique paper sculptures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位艺术家以其独特的纸雕而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Artist Rogan Brown is known for turning delicate sheets of paper into impressive 3-D coral reef sculptures.

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: turning delicate sheets of paper into
vocab_pack.definition_en: to change or transform something into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作介词 for 的宾语，turning 为 turn 的-ing 形式，后接宾语及 into 介词短语，表示“将纸片变成雕塑”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She turned an old box into a beautiful bookshelf.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把一个旧箱子变成了一个漂亮的书架。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Artist Rogan Brown is known for turning delicate sheets of paper into impressive 3-D coral reef sculptures.

vocab_pack.definition_en: very fine, thin, or easily damaged
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰 sheets of paper，表示纸片轻薄易损。
vocab_pack.example_en: The delicate flower petals were easily torn by the wind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这些娇嫩的花瓣很容易被风撕裂。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Artist Rogan Brown is known for turning delicate sheets of paper into impressive 3-D coral reef sculptures.

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing admiration or respect because of size, skill, or quality
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 令人印象深刻的；令人赞叹的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰 sculptures，表示雕塑作品令人印象深刻。
vocab_pack.example_en: The student's project was impressive and earned high praise.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那个学生的项目令人印象深刻，获得了高度赞扬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Artist Rogan Brown is known for turning delicate sheets of paper into impressive 3-D coral reef sculptures.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to increase people's knowledge or understanding of a subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，与 to 构成不定式表目的；raise 为原形，awareness 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The campaign aims to raise awareness about environmental protection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项活动旨在提高人们对环境保护的认识。
vocab_pack.from_passage: His work shows endless cases of what can happen when art and conservation come together to raise awareness and inspire change.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to motivate or encourage people to make a change
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，与 to 构成不定式表目的；inspire 为原形，change 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Great leaders inspire change through their vision.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 伟大的领导者通过他们的愿景激发变革。
vocab_pack.from_passage: His work shows endless cases of what can happen when art and conservation come together to raise awareness and inspire change.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be likely to cause damage or danger to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在进行时的被动语态，are being threatened 表示“正在受到威胁”，主语 coral reefs 是受动者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many species are threatened by habitat loss.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多物种因栖息地丧失而受到威胁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Coral reefs worldwide are being threatened by pollution and habitat destruction.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of destroying the natural environment where plants or animals live
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词 by 的宾语，与 pollution 并列，表示珊瑚礁受威胁的原因之一。
vocab_pack.example_en: Habitat destruction is a major threat to biodiversity.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 栖息地破坏是对生物多样性的主要威胁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Coral reefs worldwide are being threatened by pollution and habitat destruction.

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a result of; due to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，后接名词性成分 this（代指上文威胁），在句中作状语表示原因。
vocab_pack.example_en: Because of the storm, the flight was delayed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 由于暴风雨，航班延误了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Because of this, it's not unusual to find examples of coral bleaching among the reefs.

vocab_pack.definition_en: not usual; uncommon or surprising
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，在 it's not unusual to do sth 结构中作表语，意为“做某事并不罕见”。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is unusual to see snow in this region in summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在这个地区夏天看到雪是不寻常的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Because of this, it's not unusual to find examples of coral bleaching among the reefs.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process where corals lose their color due to stress, often leading to death
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作 find 的宾语，是珊瑚礁受威胁的一种表现。
vocab_pack.example_en: Rising water temperatures cause coral bleaching worldwide.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 水温升高导致全球珊瑚白化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Because of this, it's not unusual to find examples of coral bleaching among the reefs.

vocab_pack.definition_en: therefore; because of what has just been mentioned
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，在句首作状语，表示因果关系，承接上文珊瑚白化及威胁。
vocab_pack.example_en: He didn't study hard. As a result, he failed the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As a result, many of Brown's sculptures are based on white paper, which barely have bright colors we often associate healthy coral reefs with.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use something as the foundation or starting point
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，are based on 表示“以……为基础”，主语 sculptures 是受动者，on 后接 white paper。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie is based on a true story.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部电影基于一个真实故事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As a result, many of Brown's sculptures are based on white paper, which barely have bright colors we often associate healthy coral reefs with.

vocab_pack.definition_en: almost not; hardly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词 have，表示几乎没有明亮的颜色。
vocab_pack.example_en: He barely had enough money to buy lunch.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他几乎没有足够的钱买午餐。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As a result, many of Brown's sculptures are based on white paper, which barely have bright colors we often associate healthy coral reefs with.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to connect something in your mind with something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 及物动词，在定语从句 we often associate healthy coral reefs with 中与介词 with 连用，表示“将健康的珊瑚礁与明亮颜色联系起来”。
vocab_pack.example_en: People often associate red with danger.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 人们通常把红色与危险联系在一起。
vocab_pack.from_passage: As a result, many of Brown's sculptures are based on white paper, which barely have bright colors we often associate healthy coral reefs with.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something to someone; supply
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 第三人称单数形式，与介词 with 连用，构成 provide ... with ... 结构，意为“向……提供……”。这里主语 This（指代作品）provide his work with a serious feeling。
vocab_pack.example_en: The library provides students with a quiet place to study.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 图书馆为学生提供一个安静的学习场所。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This provides much of his work with a serious feeling as the viewer sees copies of pale, damaged coral.

vocab_pack.definition_en: sometimes but not often
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词作状语，修饰整个句子，表示有些颜色偶尔会出现在作品中。
vocab_pack.example_en: Occasionally, we go for a walk in the park after dinner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 偶尔，我们晚饭后去公园散步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Occasionally, some color does get into his work, but is often used to highlight the contrast between bleached and healthy coral.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to enter or become part of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，与 does 连用强调“确实进入”，主语 some color，get into 表示颜色进入作品中。
vocab_pack.example_en: How did the water get into the basement?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 水是怎么进入地下室的？
vocab_pack.from_passage: Occasionally, some color does get into his work, but is often used to highlight the contrast between bleached and healthy coral.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to emphasize or make something stand out
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式（to highlight）表目的，被动语态 is used 之后，意为“被用来突出对比”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report highlights the importance of early education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份报告强调了早期教育的重要性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Occasionally, some color does get into his work, but is often used to highlight the contrast between bleached and healthy coral.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be spent or used in something (e.g., effort, time)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作后置定语修饰 the sweat，表示“投入作品中的汗水”。
vocab_pack.example_en: A lot of hard work goes into preparing for the exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 备考需要投入很多努力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The sweat going into Brown's pieces is undeniable.

vocab_pack.definition_en: clearly true; impossible to deny
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，描述 the sweat going into Brown's pieces 是确凿无疑的。
vocab_pack.example_en: The impact of climate change is undeniable.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 气候变化的影响是不可否认的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The sweat going into Brown's pieces is undeniable.

vocab_pack.definition_en: with great care and effort
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 煞费苦心地；极其仔细地
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词 cut，表示极其仔细地剪出形状。
vocab_pack.example_en: She painstakingly painted every detail of the portrait.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她煞费苦心地描绘了肖像的每一个细节。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One can imagine how much time it must take him to painstakingly cut the shapes out of paper and the attention that is needed to apply them to the larger sculpture.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to divide or separate something with a sharp tool
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式（to cut）表目的，与 out of 连用表示“从纸中剪出形状”。此处为原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please cut the paper into small pieces.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请把纸剪成小片。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One can imagine how much time it must take him to painstakingly cut the shapes out of paper and the attention that is needed to apply them to the larger sculpture.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something onto a surface or to use something in a particular situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式（to apply）表目的，与 to 连用，表示将剪好的形状粘贴到更大的雕塑上。
vocab_pack.example_en: Apply the glue evenly to the surface.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 将胶水均匀地涂在表面上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: One can imagine how much time it must take him to painstakingly cut the shapes out of paper and the attention that is needed to apply them to the larger sculpture.

vocab_pack.definition_en: worth the time, money, or effort spent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，主语 the work 表示工作/作品是值得的。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is worthwhile to spend time learning a new language.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花时间学习一门新语言是值得的。

vocab_pack.definition_en: very similar to a real person or thing; realistic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与 so ... that 结构连用，表示雕塑如此逼真以至于……
vocab_pack.example_en: The sculpture is so lifelike that it seems to breathe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这尊雕塑如此逼真，好像在呼吸一样。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each of his sculptures is so lifelike that it's hard to believe we're not looking at images taken in nature.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to show the result of a particular degree of a quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定结构，so 后接形容词 lifelike，that 引导结果状语从句，表示“如此逼真以至于……”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那部电影如此无聊，以至于我睡着了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Each of his sculptures is so lifelike that it's hard to believe we're not looking at images taken in nature.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to do something to achieve a goal or solve a problem
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式（to take action）作宾语补足语，remind sb to do sth 结构，表示提醒人们采取行动。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government must take action to reduce pollution.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府必须采取行动减少污染。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It reminds people to take action to preserve coral.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep something in its original state or in good condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式（to preserve）表目的，作为 take action 的目的，表示采取行动以保护珊瑚。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to preserve natural resources for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要为后代保护自然资源。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It reminds people to take action to preserve coral.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be limited to a particular group or area
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态的一部分，are not restricted to 表示“不局限于”，主语 Brown's designs，restricted 为过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scholarship is restricted to students from low-income families.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该奖学金仅限于来自低收入家庭的学生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: However, Brown's designs are not restricted to sculptures.

section_2_word_form.passage:
The Great Wall was built over centuries by China's emperors in defense of their territory, and [56] for thousands of miles along China's historic northern border today.
The one thing most people "know" about the Great Wall — it is the only man-made structure [57] is visible from space — is probably not true. Since the Wall looks a lot like the stone and soil surrounding it, [58] is difficult to see it with the human eye even from low Earth orbit or to get it [59] in most orbital photos. However, this doesn't take away the wonder of this astonishing ancient structure.
The emperors of many Chinese dynasties throughout history instituted wall-building projects [60] the land from northern invasion(入侵). One [61] section of such an ancient wall in Shandong Province is made out of hard-packed soil and estimated to be about 2,500 years old. For centuries during the Warring States period, before China [62] together into one nation, such walls defended the borders. In the 17th century, the Wall became less important [63] a defense; however, it has preserved its symbolic [64], representing Chinese identity and culture.
Countless visitors view the Wall every year. It may be unlikely to be visible from space, [65] it is considered "an absolute masterpiece" on Earth.

questions.explanation: 句中and连接两个并列谓语，主语为The Great Wall，时间状语为today，故此处表述现在的情况，需用一般现在时，且主语为单数，故填stretches。易错点：受前文was built干扰而误填stretched。
questions.supplement: 正确形(stretches)：语境句：The vast desert stretches for thousands of miles. 固定搭配：stretch out, stretch for。原词stretch其它变形：stretched(adj. 伸展的), stretchy(adj. 有弹性的)

questions.explanation: 此处为定语从句，修饰先行词structure。当先行词被the only, the very等修饰时，关系代词只能用that，不能用which。易错点：误填which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：This is the only book that I want to read right now. 固定搭配：the only ... that, all that。

questions.explanation: 此处考察it作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式短语to see it... or to get it...。句型：It is + adj. + to do sth。易错点：误填this或that。
questions.supplement: 正确形(it)：语境句：It is highly important to learn a foreign language. 固定搭配：make it clear, take it easy。

questions.explanation: 此处考察“get + 宾语 + 宾补”结构。宾语it（指代长城）与distinguish（辨认出）之间是动宾（被动）关系，故用过去分词作宾补，表示“使它被辨认出来”。易错点：误填distinguishing或to distinguish。
questions.supplement: 正确形(distinguished)：语境句：The unique design keeps the product distinguished from others. 固定搭配：distinguish A from B, be distinguished by。原词distinguish其它变形：distinguishable(adj.), distinguishing(adj.)

questions.explanation: 此处表示建造城墙项目的目的，“为了保护土地免受北方入侵”，故使用动词不定式作目的状语。易错点：误填protecting作定语，语境更强调目的。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to protect)：语境句：We should wear sunglasses to protect our eyes from the strong sunlight. 固定搭配：protect... from/against, environmental protection。原词protect其它变形：protection(n.), protective(adj.)

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词section，作前置定语。exist常以现在分词形式existing作形容词，意为“现存的，现有的”。易错点：误填existed，exist为不及物动词，通常不用过去分词作前置定语表示“已存在的”。
knowledge_points: 非谓语动词转化形容词
questions.supplement: 正确形(existing)：语境句：The manager decided to improve the existing software system. 固定搭配：existing problems, currently existing。原词exist其它变形：existence(n.), existent(adj.)

questions.explanation: 在“before China [bring] together...”从句中，主语China与bring之间是被动关系，且该动作发生在过去的战国时期之后（历史事件），故用一般过去时的被动语态。易错点：误填brought或had been brought。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was brought)：语境句：The issue was brought to the public's attention yesterday. 固定搭配：bring together, bring about, bring up。原词bring其它变形：brought(pt./pp.), bringing(v.ing)

questions.explanation: 长城“作为”防御工事的重要性降低了。介词as意为“作为”，符合语境。易错点：由于缺乏词根提示，可能想不出合适的介词，误填for。
questions.supplement: 正确形(as)：语境句：She works as a volunteer teacher in a remote local school. 固定搭配：regard as, serve as, act as。

questions.explanation: 空前为形容词symbolic（象征性的），故此处需要填名词形式。significant的名词是significance。易错点：拼写错误或填错词性。
questions.supplement: 正确形(significance)：语境句：The scientific discovery is of great significance to medical research. 固定搭配：cultural significance, historical significance。原词significant其它变形：significantly(adv.), signify(v.)

questions.explanation: 前半句说“从太空不太可能看得见它”，后半句说“它被认为是地球上的绝对杰作”，前后语意存在明显的转折关系，故填连词but或yet。易错点：误填however，however作副词不能直接连接两个分句（除非有分号）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(but/yet)：语境句：The task was incredibly difficult, but he managed to finish it on time. 固定搭配：not only... but also, anything but。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to construct something by putting parts together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时被动语态（was built），built是build的过去分词，表示长城被建造。
vocab_pack.example_en: It took thousands of workers to build the Great Wall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 建造长城花费了成千上万的工人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: for the purpose of protecting or defending
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，在句中作状语，修饰built，表示建造的目的——保卫领土。
vocab_pack.example_en: They took up arms in defense of their country.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们拿起武器保卫祖国。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to extend over a large area or distance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时第三人称单数（stretches），主语The Great Wall，表示长城绵延数千英里。
vocab_pack.example_en: The desert stretches for hundreds of miles.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 沙漠绵延数百英里。

vocab_pack.definition_en: over a very long distance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作程度/距离状语，修饰动词stretches，表示延伸的距离。
vocab_pack.example_en: The river flows for thousands of miles to the sea.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这条河流经数千英里入海。

vocab_pack.definition_en: can be seen from a particular place or distance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为定语从句中的系表结构：is是be的第三人称单数形式，visible为形容词，from引出观察点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lighthouse is visible from the shore.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 从岸边可以看到灯塔。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to strongly resemble someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时第三人称单数（looks），用作系动词，a lot like是程度副词+介词短语，表示与…非常相似。
vocab_pack.example_en: This new building looks a lot like the old one.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座新建筑看起来很像旧的那座。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be all around something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词surrounding作定语，修饰the stone and soil，表示“环绕它的石头和泥土”。
vocab_pack.example_en: A high wall surrounds the garden.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一堵高墙环绕着花园。

vocab_pack.definition_en: using one's eyes without any aid
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰see it，表示“用肉眼看见”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The planet is barely visible with the human eye.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这颗行星肉眼几乎看不见。

vocab_pack.definition_en: an orbit around Earth at an altitude of approximately 2,000 km or less
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词from的宾语，表示“从近地轨道”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many satellites operate in low Earth orbit.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多卫星在近地轨道运行。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recognize or point out the differences between things
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中“get it distinguished”为“get + 宾语 + 过去分词”结构，distinguished是过去分词，表示使长城被区分出来。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is sometimes difficult to distinguish between the two colours.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有时很难区分这两种颜色。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove or lessen the effect of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为否定一般现在时（doesn't take away），take为原形，away为副词，表示“不减少其奇妙之处”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Nothing can take away the memory of that wonderful day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 没有什么能抹去那美好一天的记忆。

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely surprising or impressive
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语，修饰ancient structure。
vocab_pack.example_en: The speed of the car was astonishing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那辆车的速度惊人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a building or construction from a very long time ago
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词of的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The archaeologists discovered an ancient structure under the ground.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 考古学家在地下发现了一处古代建筑。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to introduce or establish a system, rule, or project
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时（instituted），主语emperors，宾语wall-building projects。
vocab_pack.example_en: The government instituted a new tax policy last year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府去年实施了一项新的税收政策。

vocab_pack.definition_en: construction plans for building walls
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合名词短语，作instituted的宾语，与文言中“wall-building”为主动形形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Several wall-building projects were initiated along the border.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 沿边境启动了数个筑墙工程。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep something safe from harm or danger
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为动词不定式（to protect），protect为原形，the land为宾语，from引出危险源。
vocab_pack.example_en: Wear a hat to protect your head from the sun.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 戴帽子保护头部免受日晒。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be constructed from a material
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时被动语态（is made），后接out of表示材料。
vocab_pack.example_en: This table is made out of solid wood.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张桌子是用实木制成的。

vocab_pack.definition_en: soil that has been tightly compressed and is dense
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作介词out of的宾语，表示材料。
vocab_pack.example_en: The path was made of hard-packed soil, perfect for walking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这条小路是由压实的泥土铺成的，很适合步行。

vocab_pack.definition_en: is roughly calculated to be a certain age or amount
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时被动语态（is estimated），后接不定式to be作主语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The building is estimated to be over 500 years old.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座建筑估计有500多年的历史。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the period in Chinese history (475–221 BCE) before unification
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 专有名词短语，作介词during的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Warring States period was a time of great philosophical development.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 战国时期是哲学思想大发展的时代。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to unite or cause to come together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中“was brought together”为被动语态，brought是bring的过去分词，表示中国被统一成一个国家。
vocab_pack.example_en: The conference aims to bring together experts from different fields.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该会议旨在汇集不同领域的专家。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to protect from attack or danger
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时（defended），主语such walls，宾语the borders。
vocab_pack.example_en: The soldiers defended the city bravely.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 士兵们勇敢地保卫了这座城市。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start to have less significance or value
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时（became），less important是比较级形容词短语，作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: As we age, material possessions become less important.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 随着年龄增长，物质财富变得不那么重要了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to maintain something in its original or good condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为现在完成时（has preserved），表示从过去到现在一直保持着象征意义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum preserves many ancient artifacts.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆保存了许多古代文物。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the importance or meaning that represents something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作preserved的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flag has great symbolic significance for the nation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这面国旗对这个国家具有重大的象征意义。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stand for or symbolize something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词representing作伴随状语，说明长城在拥有象征意义的同时，也代表着中国的身份与文化。
vocab_pack.example_en: The colour red often represents good luck in Chinese culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 红色在中国文化中常常代表好运。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very large number of tourists
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作句子主语，view是谓语动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Countless visitors come to see the Great Wall every year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每年有无数游客来参观长城。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look at or observe
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时，主语countless visitors为复数，view用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Tourists can view the exhibits from a glass walkway.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 游客可以从玻璃走道上观看展品。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be regarded or thought of as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时被动语态（is considered），后接不定式或名词短语作主语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is considered one of the greatest scientists of our time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她被认为是当代最伟大的科学家之一。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a perfect or outstanding work of art
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，在句中作主语补足语（is considered的宾语补足语）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The novel is an absolute masterpiece of world literature.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部小说是世界文学的绝对杰作。
